description: Provincial Public Service Commission-W..P. -Order pertaining to the delegation of powers of the Western Provincial Public Service under the Provincial Council Act. (42/1987) (w.e.f. 26.06.2018)
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with the delegation of powers for public service administration within the Western Province, including appointments, transfers, promotions, dismissals, and disciplinary control of provincial public officers. It focuses on public sector service conditions, recruitment procedures, and administrative delegation within the provincial public service framework, which aligns with the definition of Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
